notes.title: Behind The Backrooms PATH 1.2.8
notes.notes:
Get ready for the big update.
Updated new maps, new items, new gameplay systems are coming.

[b]FIXED[/b] : Drop Item System
[b]FIXED[/b] : Setting Menu (Some Option Not Save)
[b]FIXED[/b] : Added More DeadCount 

[b]ADDED[/b] : Player Can Stack Key Item
[b]ADDED[/b] : BootScreen
[b]ADDED[/b] : Can Switch PickUp Items

[b]FIXED[/b] : Delay Dead And Restart Screen
[b]FIXED[/b] : Player Stuck On Load To Next Level

                     (Now All Player Have Loading Screen)

[b]UPDATED[/b] : Added Option Mouse Invert X and Y

Thank you for continuing to follow and support!
